With the Furnimatic you can trade in Furni you no longer use for something new!

1. Go to the Furnimatic in the Shop.
2. Click an empty slot and choose a Furni from your Inventory. Only Furni with the green recycle icon can go in.
3. All 8 slots filled? Then press Start!
4. After a few seconds you'll find a Furni-Matic Box in your Inventory. Open it and find out what you've won!

The rarer the prize, the smaller the chance. On the Furnimatic prizes page you can see which Furni you can win and what your chances are.

Please note: Furni you put into the Furnimatic can't be returned.

Selling stuff:
You can sell any tradeable item by selecting it in your inventory and clicking 'Sell on Marketplace'. You can put 5 items up for sale for 1 credit. You can't sell items that are currently in the shop.

Buying stuff:
Find the item you want to buy on the Marketplace Offers page and click Buy. We guarantee you'll get the item for the lowest price at the time of purchase.

Requirements: to use the Marketplace you need a Trading Pass. For that, 1) your email address must be verified, 2) your account must be at least 1 day old and 3) you must have been online for at least 1 hour in total.

Variabelen worden gebruikt om waarden op:
Variables are used to store values and read them later with Wired. For example, you can use them to store a user's health points. Variables can belong to users, furni or even the whole room! You can also share them across multiple rooms. But how do you use them?

Wired Variables work differently from all existing Wired boxes, because they aren't stacked on regular Wired boxes like Triggers and Effects. Wired Variables form a new kind of Wired stack (let's call it a "Variable stack") that determines how the variable works.

In a regular Wired stack, a Wired Effect sits on a Wired Trigger. In a Variable stack there is one "WIRED Variable", and on top of it you can place Variable Add-Ons to configure the variable further. The boxes for a Variable stack all have a similar design, so you can easily see whether a box belongs to a variable!
